statement: Cochliobolus heterostrophus (=Bipolaris maydis) heterothallic, MAT-1 (alpha box) and MAT-2 (HMG) alternate idiomorphs; MAT-1 strain C5, MAT-2 strain C4
source: Turgeon et al. 1993 Mol Gen Genet 238:270

statement: heterothallic species have alternate MAT genes in different nuclei; homothallic Cochliobolus species carry both MAT genes (linked or fused)
source: Yun et al. 1999 PNAS 96:5592

statement: Phaeosphaeria (Parastagonospora) nodorum heterothallic; isolates of both mating types in field populations
source: Bennett et al. 2003 Fungal Genet Biol 40:25

statement: 1,207 isolates from 18 fields: mating type frequencies and spatial distribution consistent with recurring sexual reproduction (population-level equal-frequency expectation)
source: Stagonospora nodorum Phytopathology 2006
how_verified: PubMed abstract read; ratio value not extracted

statement: Leptosphaeria maculans MAT1-1 (alpha) and MAT1-2 (HMG) isolates; single gene per idiomorph
source: Cozijnsen and Howlett 2003 Curr Genet 43:351

statement: Mycosphaerella graminicola MAT1-1 (alpha1, isolate IPO323) and MAT1-2 (HMG, isolate IPO94269); absolute cosegregation with mating type in F1; equal distribution of alleles in field isolates
source: Waalwijk et al. 2002 Fungal Genet Biol 35:277

statement: Mycosphaerella fijiensis mat1-1 (alpha box) and mat1-2 (HMG) idiomorphs isolated
source: Conde-Ferraez et al. 2007 Mol Plant Pathol 8:111

statement: C. beticola heterothallic at MAT1; every isolate also carries exon fragments of BOTH MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 at other loci (also C. zeae-maydis, not Z. tritici)
source: Bolton et al. 2014 Fungal Genet Biol 62:43

statement: C. fulvum (presumed asexual) carries MAT1-1-1 or MAT1-2-1 per strain; 86 strains departed from 1:1
source: Stergiopoulos et al. 2007 Fungal Genet Biol 44:415

statement: heterothallic with an annual sexual cycle
source: Venturia inaequalis linkage map, BMC Res Notes 2009
how_verified: PubMed abstract read (statement of heterothallism only)

statement: MAT1-1-1 in one draft genome; of 14 sequenced isolates 7 MAT1-1-1 and 7 MAT1-2-1; 784 isolates 1:1
source: Young et al. 2018 Phytopathology 108:837

statement: D. pinea: complete MAT1-1 (MAT1-1-1, MAT1-1-4) and MAT1-2 (MAT1-2-1, MAT1-2-5) in different isolates; 1:1 in populations
source: Bihon et al. 2014 Fungal Genet Biol 62:55

statement: MAT loci from genome assemblies of Botryosphaeria, Macrophomina, Diplodia, Lasiodiplodia, Neofusicoccum: nine species homothallic, seven heterothallic; MAT fragments flank the loci
source: Nagel et al. 2018 Fungal Genet Biol 114:24

statement: E. darliae and E. pseudodarliae carry MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 in one genome (MAT1-1-1 at a separate locus); E. tritici-australis isolates carry one gene each
source: Thynne et al. 2017 Fungal Genet Biol 109:36

statement: each isolate contains both MAT idiomorphs (MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1); self-fertile; deletion of either gene abolishes pseudothecia
source: Ptr knockout study Fungal Genet Biol 2017

statement: homothallic loculoascomycete; confirmed in a global strain collection
source: Phytopathology 2010

statement: all four sequenced A. pullulans varieties (A. pullulans, A. melanogenum, A. subglaciale, A. namibiae) contain a homothallic MAT locus
source: Gostincar et al. 2014 BMC Genomics 15:549

statement: D. clematidis and Peyronellaea pinodes homothallic (fused MAT1/2 by crossover, and crossover plus inversion); P. pinodella, D. vitalbina, P. clematidina heterothallic
source: Woudenberg et al. 2012 Mol Plant Pathol 13:350

statement: ~700 isolates carry one idiomorph each; population genetic signal of cryptic sex
source: Sci Rep 2015
how_verified: PubMed abstract read (idiomorph frequency not extracted)

statement: MAT1-1 ORF encodes alpha box protein; two MAT genes sequenced in 26 species
source: Mycologia 2014

statement: BioSample SAMN03284776 strain ArDII states mating_type MAT1-2
source: NCBI BioSample (submitter statement)

statement: BioSample SAMN12143997 strain albino states mating_type MAT1-1
source: NCBI BioSample (submitter statement)
